prompts.chat: Picture people at a logistics startup in Pune and a bank's ops team in Mumbai, using a team chat app with channels, DMs, threads, shared files, canvases and call notes. List 75 things they would really type into its search bar over a normal week. Write them the way people actually type: mostly short and lowercase, sometimes a full question, now and then a typo or abbreviation. Where it feels natural, include who said what, channel names, file types, dates, unread or saved messages. Mix plain topic searches with ones that stack several conditions, a few that exclude something, and a few that ask for an order. Invent your own names and topics. One query per line, nothing else: no numbers, bullets, quotes or notes.
